text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Limited data are available regarding overdosage of ferumoxytol in humans. Excessive dosages of ferumoxytol may lead to accumulation of iron in storage sites potentially leading to hemosiderosis. Do not administer ferumoxytol to patients with iron overload [Warnings and Precautions ( 5.3 )]. Ferumoxytol is not removed by hemodialysis .
